scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Screened 1,719 unique recent cs.AI/cs.CL titles and508 recent cs.RO listings, overlapping the November16 full pass and the trailing30day window. Verified555 candidate primary arXiv abstracts and explicit v1 histories, plus four supplemental arXiv papers and one author-uploaded alphaXiv exclusive: 423 additions and137 scope exclusions. Supplemented historical research-planning omissions (Research Preference Models, AIM and AutoLLMResearch); preserved their actual first-public dates. Retrieved12 full v1 paper renderings and checked43 official project/artifact pages, including all prior paper news picks. Inspected project links separately from configured-repository star refresh, rejecting baseline/template repositories and publication-only URLs. Reassessed all10 prior news items; the proposed new edition awaits maintainer approval. Bounded search, not a claim of complete literature coverage.
